Process Diagram is explained here > https://app.diagrams.net/#G1XoMq8inHHIWf8zvcO6pSAqPWPwfaj7En#{"pageId"%3A"IpuhzhrogtEhxp1yop15"}

Invoice Cancelation process happens in Billing > Invoice Cancelation

Invoice Cancelation Document should have number generated by the system with format same as invoice but should start from 0.

The logic in DB should be the same, only difference is invoice cancelation document does not have draft, it is only real.

The Cancel Invoice document rules below apply to real (non-proforma) invoices only. When a proforma invoice is cancelled, the system shall not create a Cancel Invoice document and shall not assign an invoice cancellation document number.

When invoice cancelation object is created (it means when invoice is cancelled), the prefix from nomenclature should be in the name for document, which will be different than the invoice prefix

Invoice_Cancelation

Customer Feedbacks: https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-2596
